parsed.rationale: Both participating records have is_test=true and reside in the same test file 'Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/PlayerControllerBehaviorTests.swift' within the Playback package. Although the Jaccard similarity is high (0.778), the two methods — 'StopBehaviorTests.stopIsIdempotent' and 'StopBehaviorTests.playAfterStopWorks' — are distinct behavioral test cases covering different stop-related scenarios (idempotency vs. play-after-stop). Structural similarity in test scaffolding (setup, teardown, assertion patterns) is expected and intentional; collapsing them would obscure the distinct behaviors under test.
